title: Unquant
description: Financial data MCP for market, company, news, macro, and US Congress research.
summary: Financial data MCP for market, company, news, macro, and US Congress research.
offersHint: Financial data MCP for market, company, news, macro, and US Congress research. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://unquant.ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: ping
toolsPreview.description: Return the Unquant MCP server status for an availability check.

toolsPreview.name: datasets_list
toolsPreview.description: List available datasets with access, freshness, and coverage details for dataset selection.

toolsPreview.name: datasets_describe
toolsPreview.description: Return the schema, filters, limits, freshness, and access details for one dataset identifier.

toolsPreview.name: datasets_search
toolsPreview.description: Search dataset identifiers, names, and descriptions with a plain-language financial-data query.

toolsPreview.name: catalog_list
toolsPreview.description: List data, signals, tools, and workflows. Filter the catalog by the agent job, theme, item type, status, or geography.

toolsPreview.name: catalog_describe
toolsPreview.description: Return the purpose, access state, inputs, and next action for one catalog entry.

toolsPreview.name: catalog_preview
toolsPreview.description: Return a labeled preview for one catalog entry with optional symbols, dates, and filters.

toolsPreview.name: feedback_submit
toolsPreview.description: Save a product request for a missing tool, dataset, or feature. Examples include backtesting and options pricing. This request helps improve coverage.

toolsPreview.name: catalog_request
toolsPreview.description: Save demand for a catalog entry after a preview, with the user goal and the preview action.

toolsPreview.name: market_price_history
toolsPreview.description: Return daily prices and volume for one ticker by date range or latest trading-session count.

toolsPreview.name: market_quote
toolsPreview.description: Return the latest available end-of-day price and volume for one ticker. This tool does not return a real-time quote.

toolsPreview.name: market_company_profile
toolsPreview.description: Return the company name, industry, exchange, market value, and basic profile fields for one ticker.

toolsPreview.name: market_fundamentals
toolsPreview.description: Return reported financial statements, ratios, and metrics for one company by quarterly or annual period.

toolsPreview.name: market_symbol_search
toolsPreview.description: Find ticker symbols by company name or ticker text for security identification.

toolsPreview.name: market_analyst_ratings
toolsPreview.description: Return the analyst rating consensus and recent rating changes for one ticker. The results are third-party opinions.

toolsPreview.name: market_earnings
toolsPreview.description: Return reported or scheduled earnings events in a date range, with an optional ticker filter.

toolsPreview.name: market_etf_holdings
toolsPreview.description: Return the largest reported holdings for one ETF, with an optional minimum weight filter.

toolsPreview.name: macro_calendar
toolsPreview.description: Return economic events in chronological order for a date range, with optional country and impact filters.

toolsPreview.name: macro_indicator
toolsPreview.description: Return observations for one economic indicator, with optional dates for the observation period.

toolsPreview.name: news_stock
toolsPreview.description: Return recent news summaries for one ticker. The tool returns summaries and does not return full article text.

toolsPreview.name: news_general
toolsPreview.description: Return recent cross-market news summaries with cursor pagination.

toolsPreview.name: news_impacts
toolsPreview.description: Return generated direction, importance, and confidence scores for recent news about selected tickers. These scores do not establish causality.

toolsPreview.name: news_article
toolsPreview.description: Return one processed news summary by story identifier. The tool does not return full article text or external links.

toolsPreview.name: macro_current_conditions
toolsPreview.description: Return generated themes for current United States macroeconomic conditions. The result includes its time and method version.

toolsPreview.name: politics_us_congress_trades
toolsPreview.description: Return reported United States congressional transactions. Filter by ticker, member, asset owner, or transaction dates.

toolsPreview.name: politics_us_congress_aggregate
toolsPreview.description: Return ticker-level totals from reported United States congressional transactions. The totals do not show current holdings or intent.

toolsPreview.name: account_request_upgrade
toolsPreview.description: Create a human-reviewed Agent Pro request after Unquant delivers useful work. The result contains a confirmation link.

toolsPreview.name: account_upgrade_status
toolsPreview.description: Return the current state of an Agent Pro request by upgrade identifier.
